summary: Most of `SpinDecomposition.lean` is generic symmetrizer/antisymmetrizer algebra on a tensor square `M ⊗[R] M`, but it is stated only for `EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 2)`; the single-particle spin operators and the trace of the exchange operator are likewise special cases of upstream-level statements. Factor the general results out and derive the spin-1/2 statements from them.
